import itertools, json
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def feats(g):
    a=np.array(g); lab,n=ndimage.label(a==2); H=len(g); W=len(g[0]); out=[]
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
        cells=list(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist()))
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        # bar = row with 3 cells; stem = single cell not on bar row
        from collections import Counter
        rc=Counter(rs); bar_r=[r for r in rs if rc[r]==3][0]
        bar_cs=sorted(c for r,c in cells if r==bar_r)
        stem=[(r,c) for r,c in cells if r!=bar_r][0]
        out.append(dict(tl_r=min(rs), tl_c=min(cs), bar_r=bar_r, bar_l=bar_cs[0], bar_c=bar_cs[1],
                        stem_r=stem[0], stem_c=stem[1], cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))/2, cc=(min(cs)+max(cs))/2,
                        H=H, W=W, up=min(rs)<H/2, up_bar=bar_r<H/2, up_stem=stem[0]<H/2))
    return out
